All five installed notices are byte-identical to the 16.2.1-2 notice set and to gcc/COPYING*, COPYING.RUNTIME at the new revision. Compilation and redistribution conditions remain separate from accepting the aggregate metadata.

The four 16.2.1-2-revision members reproduce the hashes retained by the 2026-09-30 review. The 16.2.1-3 GCC snapshot archive itself was not downloaded; its manifest SHA-512 is recorded. No independent detached RPM or release-signature verification is claimed. HTTPS source provenance plus exact hashes and the successful build mapping support this bounded source comparison; this is not a reproducible-build proof.

sourceComparison.specDelta: Outside %changelog the spec changes the snapshot DATE/gitrev (20260819/95ef1679 to 20261029/9854b2ab) and gcc_release (2 to 3), regroups the configure options into common, native and cross sets, adds a RISC-V option for RHEL 11 and adds cross-gcc and sysroot subpackages, build and install steps that are disabled on Fedora 44 (build_cross 0, build_sysroot 0). The single source-wide License line, every Source and Patch entry, the existing %files sections and the %license gcc/COPYING* COPYING.RUNTIME installation are unchanged; no subpackage License override exists.
